responsibility: This is the main implementation of GNU Modula-2's heap-managed dynamic string type in the mc-boot runtime. It owns the concrete string record, descriptor, and debug metadata structures; provides construction, destruction, concatenation, slicing, case conversion, equality, indexing, C-string exposure, and copy-out services; and also contains optional allocation-tracking and leak-detection support through push/pop allocation frames and debug-tagged helper variants, making it the central mutable string subsystem used by formatting, numeric conversion, file, and runtime support modules.
same_name_distinction: Concrete implementation half of the DynamicStrings pair: unlike GDynamicStrings.h's opaque API surface, this file defines the internal string, descriptor, debug-info, and allocation-frame structures and the full heap-management logic behind the exported operations.
